**Extraction Method:**
- **Current Quarter**: NII ₹25,339cr + Fee Income ₹7,795cr + Other Income ₹482cr (derived from Core Operating Profit ₹20,805cr − Op Ex ₹12,811cr) = Total Income ₹33,616cr. PBT ₹19,954cr is "Profit before tax excluding treasury" as stated. PAT ₹14,843cr stated directly.
- **Previous Quarter**: Insufficient data in transcript (only NII sequential growth of 3.9% provided; no other P&L metrics).
- **Year Ago**: All figures back-calculated from stated YoY growth rates (NII ÷1.177, Fee ÷1.201, etc.). Revenue derived similarly using Core Op Profit framework.
